answer: Require each identity to escrow a 960-unit bond and serve a forty-epoch probation. Each round it completes one random task and gathers four endorsements from reviewers with disjoint recent partners; reused proofs, copied sentences, or same-window submissions freeze the bond for twenty rounds. The ledger verifies signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil farm locks 960 units per alias and replays forty rounds, while a gale of matched traces exposes the ring, echo records anchor each review, and zephyr-sealed receipts certify provenance.
